# Group

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.mobject.Group`

class Group(*\*mobjects*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Mobject`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject")

    Groups together multiple [`Mobjects`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject").

    Notes

    When adding the same mobject more than once, repetitions are ignored.
    Use [`Mobject.copy()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.copy "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.copy") to create a separate copy which can then
    be added to the group.
